responsibility: Declares the public target-side interfaces shared between the PDP-11 machine description, header macros, and pdp11.cc implementation. The prototypes cover operand predicates and address printers, condition-code tracking helpers, multiword move/shift/cmp emitters and length calculators, operand expansion utilities, frame elimination and prologue/epilogue support, stack rounding, symbol/label and variable assembly output, and small target-specific enums used by splitters and output routines, making this the declaration bridge for the backend’s C++ support code.
